title: 第19章 也是时候突破一下了第20章 杳杳师姐到底有多强
slug: 满级师妹她缺德但能打
content_zh:
云杳杳在丹堂那番“微观论道”
引发的震动尚未平息，另一则消息又如旋风般传遍了青云宗——五年一度的宗门大比，即将在一个月后正式开启！
不同于之前的小比热身，宗门大比是青云宗真正的盛事，关乎各峰资源分配、弟子排名乃至进入“秘境福地”
的资格，可谓万众瞩目。
内门外门弟子皆可参加，根据修为划分不同组别进行比试，竞争极为激烈。
消息一出，整个宗门的气氛瞬间变得紧张而热烈。
修炼坪上人影攒动，术法光芒日夜不息；藏书阁内人头济济，争相借阅功法玉简；丹堂器阁更是生意兴隆，各种丹药法器供不应求。
忘忧峰却依旧是一片“异类”
的祥和。
炎铮摩拳擦掌，整天拉着石猛对练，火花带闪电，打得忘忧峰后山一片狼藉，美其名曰“为大比热身”
石猛则一边陪练，一边不忘给云杳杳捎带新研究的药膳点心。
顾沧溟虽依旧沉默，但练剑的时间明显延长，周身剑气愈发凛冽。
唯有事件中心的云杳杳，依旧该吃吃该喝喝，时不时溜达去各峰“指导”
工作，对大比似乎毫无紧张感。
“小师妹！
你就一点都不急吗？”
炎铮又一次对练完，顶着一头被雷燎过的卷发冲进院子，看到云杳杳正优哉游哉地给一盆新买的“月光菇”
浇水，顿时恨铁不成钢，“大比啊！
到时候各峰天才都会出来！
听说主峰那几个妖孽都出关了！

你就不想拿个好名次？”
云杳杳放下小水壶，眨了眨眼：“名次？有什么奖励吗？是好吃的还是好玩的？”
炎铮一噎，捶胸顿足：“奖励当然丰厚！
但重点是扬名立万啊！
让所有人都知道我们忘忧峰的厉害！”
“哦。”
云杳杳点点头，又拿起旁边石猛刚送来的奶香灵薯饼咬了一口，含糊道，“可是扬名立万好像挺累的…而且，我们忘忧峰不是一直很厉害吗？”
她说着，看向旁边默默擦剑的顾沧溟和憨笑点头的石猛。
炎铮：“…”
好像无法反驳。
顾沧溟擦剑的动作顿了顿，抬眼看向云杳杳，淡淡道：“随心即可。”
意思很明显，她想玩就去玩，不想玩也没人敢逼她。
云杳杳弯起眼睛笑了：“还是大师兄懂我。”
她确实对争名次没什么兴趣。
在她看来，那种擂台比试限制太多，远不如研究新菜谱或者优化基础功法来得有趣。
不过…若是大比奖励里有特别稀有的食材或者有趣的古籍，倒是可以考虑去凑个热闹。
就在宗门上下为大比积极备战之际，一丝若有若无的阴霾，却悄然笼罩下来。
是夜，月黑风高。
云杳杳正在静室内进行她的“微观修炼”
content_en:
Yun Yaoyao’s “microcosmic discussion” in Dantang
The shock has not yet subsided, and another piece of news has spread throughout the Qingyun Sect like a whirlwind - the sect competition that is held every five years will officially start in one month!
Different from the previous small competition warm-up, the sect competition is the real grand event of Qingyun Sect, which is related to the allocation of resources in each peak, the ranking of disciples and even entering the "secret blessed land"
His qualifications are attracting much attention.
Both inner and outer disciples can participate. Different groups are divided into different groups based on their cultivation. The competition is extremely fierce.
As soon as the news came out, the atmosphere in the entire sect instantly became tense and heated.
There are many people on the training ground, and the magic technique shines day and night; the library pavilion is full of people, vying to borrow the jade slips of the exercises; the Alchemy Hall Equipment Pavilion is doing a booming business, and the supply of various elixirs and magic tools exceeds the demand.
Wangyou Peak is still a "heterogeneous" place
of peace.
Yan Zheng geared up and started sparring with Shi Meng all day long. The sparks and lightning caused a mess on the mountain behind Wangyou Peak. He called it "warming up for the big competition".
Shi Meng, while sparring, did not forget to bring Yun Yao Yao's newly researched medicinal snacks.
Although Gu Cangming remained silent, his sword practice time was obviously extended, and the sword energy around him became more and more sharp.
Only Yun Yaoyao, who was at the center of the incident, still had to eat and drink, and would wander to various peaks from time to time to "give guidance".
At work, Dabi seems to have no nervousness at all.
"Little junior sister!
Are you not in a hurry at all? "
After another sparring session, Yan Zheng rushed into the yard with his curly hair struck by lightning, and saw Yun Yaoyao leisurely feeding a pot of newly purchased "Moonlight Mushrooms"
Watering the water, he immediately hated the iron and said, "Dabi!
By then the geniuses from all peaks will come out!
I heard that those monsters on the main peak have all left seclusion!
Don’t you want to get a good ranking? "
Yun Yaoyao put down the small kettle and blinked: "Ranking? Is there any reward? Is it delicious or fun?"
Yan Zheng choked and beat his chest: "Of course the reward will be huge!
But the point is to make a name for yourself!
Let everyone know how powerful our Wangyou Peak is! "
"Oh."
Yun Yaoyao nodded, took a bite of the milk-flavored potato cake that Shi Meng had just sent next to him, and said vaguely, "But becoming famous seems to be quite tiring... Besides, haven't we at Wangyou Peak always been very powerful?"
As she spoke, she looked at Gu Cangming, who was silently cleaning his sword, and Shi Meng, who nodded with a naive smile.
Yan Zheng: "..."
It seems impossible to refute.
Gu Cangming paused in the action of cleaning his sword, raised his eyes to Yun Yaoyao, and said calmly: "Just do whatever you want."
The meaning is obvious, she can play if she wants to, and no one dares to force her if she doesn't want to play.
Yun Yaoyao bent his eyes and smiled: "Elder brother still understands me."
She really has no interest in competing for ranking.
In her opinion, that kind of competition in the arena has too many restrictions and is far less interesting than studying new recipes or optimizing basic skills.
However...if the competition rewards include particularly rare ingredients or interesting ancient books, you might consider joining in the fun.
While everyone in the sect was actively preparing for the competition, a vague haze quietly enveloped them.
It was night, the moon was dark and the wind was high.
Yun Yaoyao is conducting her "microscopic practice" in a quiet room
